Also causes reversible inhibition of immunocompetent lymphocytes in the G0- and G1-phase of the cell cycle. It has a role as an anticoronaviral agent, a geroprotector, a metabolite, an immunosuppressive agent, an antifungal agent, an antirheumatic drug, an EC 3.1.3.16 (phosphoprotein phosphatase) inhibitor, an anti-asthmatic drug, a dermatologic drug and a carcinogenic agent.", "provider": null, "url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/searchId.do?chebiId=CHEBI:4031"}], "BRD-A55453956": [{"source_id": "pubchem:11306390:description:1", "text": "Compound E is an L-alanine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-[(3,5-difluorophenyl)acetyl]-L-alanine with the amino group of (3S)-3-amino-1-methyl-5-phenyl-1,3-dihydro-2H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one. An inhibitor of memapsin 2 (gamma-secretase). It has a role as an EC 3.4.23.46 (memapsin 2) inhibitor. donors.reason: Immunosuppressant inhibiting phosphoprotein phosphatase; high anchor similarity may transfer histone response.
Gamma-secretase inhibitor; high anchor similarity supports donor transfer for histone perturbation.
Tyrosine kinase inhibitor like vandetanib; moderate anchor similarity supports transfer.

revised_hypotheses: Vandetanib may produce a reproducible histone perturbation in A375 cells at 0.333 uM for 24 h, with H3K4me2 (BI10005) as the strongest anchor feature.

Donors with high anchor similarity and relevant pharmacology (Cyclosporine, Compound E, Axitinib, semagacestat) are more likely to transfer a target-minus-A375 response preserving the Vandetanib histone signature.
The fixed external decoder may select a target cell/feature/sign; transferred histone perturbation should exceed 0.5 log2 versus vehicle without viability or causal claims.
